title: Encryption, Keys & Secrets
summary: Encryption in flight, at rest and client-side; AWS KMS key types, policies, rotation, pricing and quotas; moving encrypted snapshots, AMIs and S3 objects across Regions and accounts; KMS multi-Region keys; SSM Parameter Store versus Secrets Manager; ACM certificates with ALB and API Gateway; and when dedicated CloudHSM beats KMS.
